item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST AI Enhances Severe Storm Predictability
item.description: Researchers at HKUST have developed a satellite-based AI system that can accurately forecast severe convective storms up to four hours in advance, improving short-term weather prediction and early warning.

item.title: Vietnam Rises as Southeast Asia’s AI Investment Hub
item.description: Vietnam is rapidly emerging as a regional AI hub, attracting global investment, expanding innovative start-ups, developing highly skilled talent and aiming to become a top-three R&D centre in Southeast Asia by 2030.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Role in Global Memory Supply Chains
item.description: Singapore’s new advanced wafer fabrication facility strengthens its semiconductor memory and AI supply chain capabilities, creating high-value jobs, fostering innovation and deepening local industry partnerships.

item.title: Exclusive! Banking on Trust: Securing Resilience and Powering Responsible Innovation
item.description: Malaysia’s BFSI sector is transforming, using resilient digital infrastructure, secure connectivity and governance-driven innovation to provide reliable, compliant, customer-focused financial services.

item.title: Thailand: Tech Diplomacy Fosters Ties with the Global Community
item.description: Thailand’s 2026 Science Diplomacy Forum in Khon Kaen showcases advanced science, technology and local wisdom to foster international collaboration and drive regional industrial development.

item.title: Malaysia: Incentive Framework Spurs Tech Adoption and Growth
item.description: Malaysia’s New Incentive Framework links investment incentives to technology adoption, sustainability and measurable economic outcomes under global tax reform pressures.

item.title: Vietnam: AI, Messaging Underpin Digital Commerce Revolution
item.description: AI, conversational commerce, and cross-border digital tools are rapidly transforming how Vietnamese businesses engage customers, drive sales and build fully integrated commerce ecosystems in 2026.

item.title: Australia: Swinburne Expands Campus-Wide Generative AI
item.description: Swinburne University has become the first globally to provide all staff and learners with campus-wide access to generative AI tools, embedding advanced creative technologies across teaching, learning and research.

item.title: The Philippines: Boosting PNP Cyber and Crime-Fighting Capabilities
item.description: A multi-billion-peso investment aims to strengthen the Philippine National Police’s crime-fighting, digital and infrastructure capabilities, including anti-cybercrime training and technology upgrades.

item.title: Singapore: Empowering the Workforce to Thrive in the AI Era
item.description: Minister Josephine Teo highlighted Singapore’s ongoing efforts to equip its workforce with AI fluency and domain expertise, actively promoting collaboration between humans and AI through the Human+ initiative.
